story: The Gullhaven Chapter's circle, The Whistlers (Nobody Left Behind, Candlelight insignia, chapter house the old chain-ferry toll shed), was Ada Quill (Scholar, Professor), Bram Okafor (Muscle, Soldier), Cass Moreau (Slink, Criminal) and Dev Lindqvist (Weird, Occultist). On the estuary flats at dusk they found a psalm stamped on every seventh link of the ferry chain, footprints that ended at the channel, and a bell that was a recording of a ring with a man counting coins to forty under it; the thing in the fog tasted Cass (a Bleed mark held for Death Defy). In the ferryman's cottage Bram braced the door, Ada read a psalm sheet whose hand changes halfway and recognised the slant from her own tome, Cass sprang the tide-ledger and found forty years of fares, and Dev learned that the portrait of Absalom Hode bore the chain's stamp. On the ferry mid-channel, with the tide turning and a ten-minute timer running, Bram jammed the windlass, Dev's salt ward stopped the counting at forty-one, Ada found her own name drying last in the fare column, and the tide threw Cass into the hold until she was at Body 3 of 3. She cut the ferryman's empty coat from the bell, Bram hauled her out and Ada read the first fare, Hode's own: he was carried over and the psalm laid to rest with 3:42 left on the timer. No one was scarred or taken out. Two questions answered yes and a key from everyone gave 6 Illumination (6 of 12, no advance), and End Assignment came at 22:55, leaving a hook: Ada's name is still last in the ledger.

timeline.what: The Lightkeeper signed up on beta, created The Gullhaven Chapter (code gullhaven-r4), toured the five desk sections and posted the code. Findings F001 to F004.
Four players signed up and built investigators on a desktop, a phone, a laptop and a tablet (portraits, emoji and Markdown in fields, gear cap), then asked to join. F005 to F014.

Requests arrived live with a badge and pop-up. The Lightkeeper read each sheet with View sheet and approved Bram, Ada, Cass and Dev; the formation papers opened on each desk without a reload. Resources showed 5/5/5. F015 to F018.
Votes, name suggestions (a tie broken by the tie rule), the chapter house, ability, insignia and eleven relationships, live on every device. F019 to F031.
Finalize in two presses sealed The Whistlers; the first dispatch went out at 22:30 and the clock 'The fog comes in' rose to 1 of 4. F032 to F034.

Four rolls with drive spends and gilded choices (one critical), Dev's photograph entry, a Bleed mark held for Cass's Death Defy, an open and a secret Lightkeeper roll, tension 2, a private note to Ada, the second dispatch. F035 to F050.

Death Defy used, Learn from My Mistakes, marks dealt to Cass, Bram and Ada, spending opened, a sketch map posted, tension 3 renamed 'The tide turns', a 10:00 timer started at 22:43 and the third dispatch. F051 to F069.

Adrenaline Rush, Great Wards, a Stitch and a Train, Cass's Edit sheet, an open tide roll of 6 taking Cass to Body 3 of 3, the resolution, timer paused at 3:42 and cleared, tension to 0, reports opened and two questions ticked. F070 to F093.
All four reports filed (one amended), Add 6 Illumination (0 to 6, correct by p. 55) and End Assignment at 22:55, live on every desk. F094 to F105.
Downtime at the toll shed: Stitch and Refresh spends, the ward moved to Ada, exit notes. F106 to F121.

bugs.title: A death lowers the circle resource maximum on the server without telling any desk, and leaves each pool above its new maximum
bugs.what_happens: In a sealed circle of 3 with Stitch 4, Refresh 4, Train 3 (max 4), a fourth scar kills one member. Live, every desk still reads 'Stitch 4 · max 4'. After a reload the Lightkeeper's desk reads 'Stitch 4 · max 3', 'Stitch: 4 of 3 available.' and 'Refills: To 3 each', while players still read 4 of 4 until they reload. When the replacement is approved the maximum returns to 4.
bugs.steps: Seal a circle of 3 with resources at max 4. Kill one member with a fourth scar. Read the Lightkeeper's roster card and Circle page, then reload both desks.
bugs.root_cause: backend/vtt/ws/handlers/character.py handle_apply_scar sends no circle_update and does not call lower_resources_to_pool; backend/vtt/circle_queries.py resource_pool counts living members only.
bugs.fix: Needs Robert's call first (see decisions). Either count the dead toward 1 plus members until a replacement is approved (resource_pool), or lower the pools on a death exactly as a release does (decisions_fix4 1). In both cases send a circle_update so every desk shows one maximum live and never a pool above it.

bugs.title: A scar owed is forgotten by the server after a restart, so the investigator can be revived with no scar
bugs.what_happens: A member takes a fourth mark and the player presses Decide later. After a backend restart and reloads, the Lightkeeper's copy and the player's stamp read only 'Incapacitated'. The player's 'A scar is waiting' banner survives only because it is kept in that browser; on another device or with cleared storage the owed scar is gone, and the Lightkeeper can Revive with no scar recorded. This breaks decisions_fix6 1 (a restart loses nothing a player can see).
bugs.steps: Deal a fourth mark, press Decide later, restart the API, reload both desks and open the sheet.
bugs.root_cause: backend/vtt/serializers.py lines 16-17: awaiting_scar is an in-memory set.
bugs.fix: Store the owed scar on the character (a column, as held_mark was stored for #17 and #43), serialize scar_pending from it and clear it when the scar is recorded or the investigator dies. Add a restart test.

bugs.title: Before the seal the Lightkeeper's charter edits the name, chapter house and ability, and a chapter house typed there silently replaces the players' answer at the seal
bugs.what_happens: Logged as UX; listed here because the seal drops what players wrote. During formation the Lightkeeper's Circle tab shows 'Unnamed Circle' with Edit, an editable Chapter house box and a live ability dropdown, with no hint that the players are deciding these. The server accepts all three. At the seal the vote overwrites her name and ability, but her chapter house wins and the players' saved answer is dropped without a word. The roster's 'Circle formation so far' panel still shows the players' house, so it disagrees with what the seal writes.
bugs.steps: New campaign, two approved members, not sealed. A player saves a chapter house in the papers. The Lightkeeper types a different one on her Circle tab. Finalize and read the chapter house.
bugs.root_cause: backend/vtt/routers/circles.py:271-281 copies the players' chapter_house only 'if not circle.chapter_house_location'; backend/vtt/ws/handlers/gm.py:521-527 handle_update_circle has no is_finalized check; frontend/src/components/gm/CirclePage.jsx:390-406 and :485 have no is_finalized guard.
bugs.fix: In finalize let a non-empty formation answer win ('if house:'), keeping the Lightkeeper's text only when players wrote nothing. Before the seal render name, house and ability read-only with one line such as 'Decided in the formation papers until the seal.' Optionally preview the leading vote and the written house.

bugs.title: The Edit sheet log line cuts old and new text at the same 40 characters, so a change late in a long field is invisible
bugs.what_happens: Cass appended words to a long Style line. The log read 'style Soot-grey coat, many pockets (key), a b... to Soot-grey coat, many pockets (key), a b...': both halves cut at the same point, so it reads as no change. Detection, not prevention (decisions_fix5 1) relies on this line naming what changed from what to what. Every free-text field is affected; numeric edits are fine.
bugs.steps: Player desk, Edit sheet. Append text after the 40th character of a long Style (or other text) field and Save. Read the Lightkeeper's Activity Log.
bugs.root_cause: backend/vtt/sheet_edits.py:42 SHOWN_MAX = 40 and :133-136 _shown() cut old and new independently to the same prefix.
bugs.fix: For free-text fields, drop the shared prefix and suffix and show the part that differs (or the added words); keep the 40-character cut for list items only. Add a test with a change after character 40.

bugs.title: A dead investigator can still file and amend an assignment report
bugs.what_happens: The dead player's Circle page keeps the report form with Send report live. The report is stored and 'Iris Vane filed an assignment report.' goes to every desk; a crafted replace:true amendment is accepted too. The Lightkeeper's Circle page shows a 'Report filed' card for the dead beside '0 of 2 filed', and the report stays after the replacement is approved. The tally appears to skip the dead, so no wrong Illumination number was seen.
bugs.steps: Seal a table with reports open. Kill an investigator with a fourth scar. On the dead desk open Circle, tick a key and press Send report.
bugs.root_cause: backend/vtt/ws/access.py DEAD_REFUSED (around line 551) lacks submit_assignment_report; backend/vtt/ws/handlers/circle.py handle_submit_assignment_report checks only status active.
bugs.fix: Add submit_assignment_report to DEAD_REFUSED (409 '<name> is dead: the sheet is a record.'), hide the form on a dead desk, and drop a dead member's report from the cards.

bugs.title: Leaving and rejoining in one assignment resets the player's circle spend count
bugs.what_happens: A player who used both spends leaves (optionally across a restart), asks to join again and is approved. He comes back with 0 spends used and can spend two more this assignment. Pools are not refilled, so only the per-player cap is bypassed, and only with the Lightkeeper's approval. A replacement keeps its predecessor's count (#41), but a returning member does not keep their own.
bugs.steps: With spending open, use both spends, Leave, ask to join again, have the Lightkeeper approve, read the spend count.
bugs.root_cause: release_from_campaign calls end_assignment_for, which zeroes resources_spent_assignment (backend/vtt/assignment.py); approve_investigator in engine.py carries a count over only from a predecessor (#41).
bugs.fix: Once Robert confirms, do not zero the spend count on release (or carry it back on approval when the same character returns within the same assignment).

bugs.title: After a server restart, a refused gilded keep still shows an outcome and offers Burn and reroll
bugs.what_happens: A gilded roll waits for its die across an API restart. After the desk reconnects, Keep the gilded is refused ('No roll is waiting for a die to be kept. Roll again.'), but the slip still reads 'kept the gilded 4 / MIXED SUCCESS' and offers Burn and reroll, which the server would also refuse. Nothing was logged at the table. Breaks decisions_fix6 2 (the tray tells the truth).
bugs.steps: Roll a gilded action with 2 or more dice and leave the choice waiting. Restart the API, let the desk reconnect, press Keep.
bugs.root_cause: frontend/src/store/gameStore.js action_rejected path near line 1170 clears pendingGildedChoice but keeps the locally kept result.
bugs.fix: On that refusal clear the slip's outcome and the burn offer and say the roll was lost to a restart ('Roll again.'). Pair with live-desk-burn-after-restart.

bugs.title: A Non-Combatant drive point card is not sent again when the ally's desk reloads inside the window
bugs.what_happens: A Doctor with Non-Combatant takes a mark; an ally gets a Non-Combatant card and a Behind Me card and reloads 8 s later. Only Behind Me comes back (expires_in 116). The server still holds the point, cannot be claimed, and its lapse line appears later. The FAQ and QUIRKS say an offer comes back with its time left after a reload.
bugs.steps: A Doctor with Non-Combatant takes a Body mark. Reload an ally's desk within 2 minutes.
bugs.root_cause: backend/vtt/ws/handlers/marks.py send_open_intercepts re-sends only Behind Me and Premonitions.
bugs.fix: Re-send pending Non-Combatant points with their time left in send_open_intercepts.

bugs.title: A Non-Combatant card outlives a server restart, and its refusal closes the card with no word
bugs.what_happens: After a restart, Behind Me and Premonitions cards are dropped on reconnect as designed, but the Non-Combatant card stays with its countdown. Use is refused ('No Non-Combatant drive point is waiting.') and the card closes silently with Nerve unchanged, so the player believes it worked. In normal play a lapsed Non-Combatant answer's refusal is also replaced by the next card and never shown. Same on the control build, so not a regression.
bugs.steps: Finn takes a mark so allies get a Non-Combatant card. Restart the API, let desks reconnect, pick NER and press Use.
bugs.root_cause: frontend/src/store/gameStore.js withoutIntercepts drops only intercept offers on socket open, and abilityMarkRefused is set only for own-mark answers.
bugs.fix: Drop Non-Combatant cards on socket open with the other ally offers, and show its refusal the way 'PREMONITIONS NOT USED' is shown (FAQ.md:120, decisions_fix6 1).

bugs.title: The server takes a new roll while a gilded choice is still waiting, and drops the first choice
bugs.what_happens: Roll Read with 0 drive (gilded pool 2, a keep needed), then roll Sway before resolving: the second roll returns a result at once and the first choice is lost. Only the desk prevents this, so a second tab or device that has not seen the choice could roll over it. FAQ line 18 says the server holds the dice until a die is kept.
bugs.steps: Over the socket: roll a gilded action that needs a keep, then send another roll before resolve_gilded.
bugs.root_cause: backend/vtt/ws/handlers/rolls.py roll handler has no pending-gilded guard.
bugs.fix: Refuse a roll while that character has a gilded choice waiting ('Keep a die from your last roll first.').

bugs.title: Non-Combatant logs 'recovered 1' for a drive that was already full, and spends the point
bugs.what_happens: Esme at Intuition 3 of 3 picks INT on a Non-Combatant card. Intuition stays 3, yet every desk logs 'Esme Rook recovered 1 Intuition (Non-Combatant).' and the point is used up. Here the answer came on a lapsed card and was credited against another point still waiting.
bugs.steps: With a drive full, answer a Non-Combatant card choosing that drive.
bugs.root_cause: backend/vtt/ws/handlers/marks.py handle_resolve_ability_mark, Non-Combatant branch, lines about 700-705.
bugs.fix: Log only what came back (as Well-Read now does) and refuse or mark a full drive in the picker.

bugs.title: A mark dealt to a closed desk lands beside a stored Death Defy hold, and the old offer comes back afterwards
bugs.what_happens: Iris has a Body mark held for Death Defy and her desk is closed. The Lightkeeper deals another Body mark; it lands at once ('Their desk is closed...') and the hold is kept. When Iris opens her desk she is offered Death Defy for the first mark after a same-harm mark already landed. Same on the control; a rules call.
bugs.steps: Hold a mark for Death Defy, close the desk, deal another mark of the same kind from the Lightkeeper's desk, open the player's desk.
bugs.root_cause: backend/vtt/ws/handlers/marks.py take_mark from the Lightkeeper's socket when no desk is open.
bugs.fix: After Robert's call: land the held mark first and close its offer (as WEBSOCKET.md 4.5 says for a mark taken while an offer holds one), or join the new mark to the offer.

bugs.title: The FAQ says the Lightkeeper revives, but the player's own sheet has Revive too, and the log does not say who revived
bugs.what_happens: An incapacitated member records the scar and presses Revive on their own trauma record; one press revives, and the log line is the same as the Lightkeeper's. FAQ.md:137 and :147 describe Revive as the Lightkeeper's.
bugs.steps: Incapacitate a member, record the scar on the player's desk, press Revive there.
bugs.fix: After Robert's call: hide Revive on the player's sheet, or keep it, update the FAQ and name who revived in the log.

bugs.title: A second Lightkeeper tab keeps the join-request pop-up and Requests count after the other tab approved
bugs.what_happens: With the Lightkeeper's desk in two tabs, approving in tab A leaves tab B showing the pop-up (now 'Already has an investigator here.') and 'Requests 1' until a reload, though its roster has the investigator. The control does the same.
bugs.steps: Open the Lightkeeper's desk in two tabs, have a player ask to join, approve in one tab, look at the other.
bugs.root_cause: OperationsPanel pending list is not cleared by the approval frame (OperationsPanel.jsx:88 intends it).
bugs.fix: Drop the card, pop-up and count in every Lightkeeper tab when the request is answered elsewhere.

bugs.title: A let-in investigator's Play button has no 'Play' in its accessible name
bugs.what_happens: After an approval the Registry row button is named 'Wren Hollis Saltmere Verify LET IN'; the visible PLAY arrow is not in the name, though the control build's button ended in '... PLAY'.
bugs.steps: Approve a waiting player and read the Registry row button's name.
bugs.root_cause: The 60.4 stamp text replaced the Play label in the button's name (campaignSelector).
bugs.fix: Keep 'Play' in the name, with the stamp as extra text.

ux.title: The Lightkeeper cannot see that a player's burn is still open, so her open roll silently ends it
ux.what_happens: Cass failed Hide and said at the table she might burn after hearing the Lightkeeper, who then made an open roll, which settles the player's last roll (FAQ.md:76, designed). On a fresh copy, with a player's burn open, the Lightkeeper's page has no word for burn, resist, reroll or settle: no roster marker, nothing by Roll. Her open roll ended it and the player's tray read 'Roll settled'.
ux.suggestion: Client only: keep a tableRollOpen flag in gameStore for the newest player roll below full success; while it is set and Secret is off, show one short line by Roll ('An open roll ends Iris's chance to burn on Survey.') or a small 'Burn open' mark on the felt slip.

ux.title: Several in-play controls are under 44px on touch: post-roll Use and Skip, scar form choices, relationship Accept and the drive picker
ux.what_happens: Post-roll Use and Skip (Flourish, Bending Spoons, Learn from My Mistakes) are 50x22 and 46x22 (RollModifications.jsx 116-135); the scar form's 18 Lower/Raise rows are 28px with 14px radios (ScarModal.jsx); Accept on a relationship paper is 39px on a touch tablet; the NER/CUN/INT picker on Non-Combatant and Adrenaline Rush cards is 30px (AbilityMarkOffer.jsx 244-258). Neighbouring primary buttons are 44px.
ux.suggestion: One sweep adding [@media(pointer:coarse)]:min-h-[44px] to these controls.
ux.evidence_detail: re-check (R031) and two side checks (R042, R043, R053)

ux.title: The Lightkeeper's roster card shows nothing while a dealt mark is held for Death Defy or a soak
ux.what_happens: After dealing a Death Defy holder a Bleed mark, the roster card stays blank under role and specialty; only the open sheet says 'Bleed mark held for Death Defy.' Low because the offer lasts about 30 s and she has just dealt it.
ux.suggestion: Add held_marks to the roster item (campaigns.py to_item) and a line in glanceOf() (InvestigatorBusinessCard.jsx:22-33) such as 'Bleed mark held: Death Defy?'.

ux.title: No desk shows that a once-per-assignment ability such as Death Defy is used, or ready again after End Assignment
ux.what_happens: After Death Defy was used, neither the Lightkeeper's copy nor the player's dossier showed a spent state (the finding's premise that the player sees 'Used this assignment' was wrong: that line is only for abilities with a Use button). After End Assignment players could not see that Learn from My Mistakes or Death Defy was ready again (F108, F115, cluster ability-ready-state-unshown).
ux.suggestion: In the dossier's ability panel show 'Used this assignment.' (and optionally 'Ready') for once-per-assignment abilities from ability_uses, on both the player's and the read-only copy. ability_uses is already serialized.

ux.title: Add N Illumination is a single press with no confirm while reports are unfiled, and only one add is allowed per assignment
ux.what_happens: Reproduced: with no report filed, one press of ADD 2 ILLUMINATION applied at once and the Not filed line vanished; a second add is refused (409). As documented (FAQ.md:248) and as the control built it, and keys filed later can still be added with +1. But decisions_fix4 5 speaks of naming non-filers 'in their existing confirm step', and Add has none. The Lightkeeper waited on purpose for fear of losing keys.

keep.title: Joining and approval are quick and clear for both sides
The character creator works on phone, laptop and tablet
Circle formation updates live on every device
Desks stay current without a reload, including a trip to the hub and back mid-scene
Rolls are correct against the book, safe against double presses, and work from the keyboard
The Lightkeeper's table tools chain together cleanly (marks, Death Defy hold, tension, clock, timer, dispatch, tally, End Assignment)
Circle resources and abilities behave as described (arm then confirm, one spend on a double click, Train +1d, Great Wards, ring tooltip)
Reports and the notebook are solid (Markdown, photos, handwriting, private notes, report filing and Amend, nothing lost at End Assignment)
From the checks: restarts are now survivable (log, held marks with the same offer id, timers, drafts, End confirm, reconnect with backoff) and the dead are a thorough record on REST and WebSocket

personas.dm: Ran the whole assignment on a 1440x900 laptop without stopping the table: sheets reviewed before approval, the seal, three dispatches, the hourglass with a named clock and a timer, open and secret rolls, marks, a sketch map in under a minute, reports, Add Illumination and End Assignment, with no console errors and no reload. Her complaints are all about seeing what players have pending: a burn still open (F047), a held mark on the roster card (F050), a spent Death Defy (F066), and Add Illumination being a single press, which she deliberately held back until every report was in (F090). She also found the charter editable during formation (F016).
personas.ada: The rules lawyer on a 1920x1080 desktop audited every number: pools, gilded choices, refunds, Learn from My Mistakes, the key rule and the +6 tally all matched the book, and the desk never went stale. What got in her way was wording: bare key names (F095), the burn preview's '2 dice' after a 3-dice roll (by design, but it read as a mistake), and no ready state for abilities between assignments.
personas.bram: The newcomer on a 390x844 phone found the roll flow, the gilded choice, Burn, Stitch and the report without help, and the desk stayed live. Friction was physical and explanatory: long scrolls to the report form and spends, a roll bar that crops the dice, an Adrenaline Rush card covering half the screen with 'Ner/Cun/Int', and a Great Wards bonus after the end that nothing explained.
personas.cass: The breaker on a 1366x768 laptop double-clicked, pressed Enter twice, reloaded with a choice pending and went to the hub and back mid-scene: nothing was duplicated or lost. She found the Edit sheet log truncation (F079), keyboard reach problems, and states between assignments that are invisible (Death Defy ready, what 12 brings, empty dispatch labels).
personas.dev: The note-keeper on an 820x1180 tablet lived in the notebook: Markdown, photographs and the handwriting font all posted cleanly and the preview matched. Friction: the photo caption under the title, relationship fields greyed with no reason, Great Wards' state before and after the end, and no hint of what Illumination 12 brings.

decisions_for_robert: death-lowers-resource-max-silently: when an investigator dies, do the dead count toward the 1 plus members maximum until a replacement is approved, or does the death lower the maximum and the pools at once as a release does (decisions_fix4 1)?

lk-charter-editable-before-seal: before the seal, should the Lightkeeper's name, chapter house and ability be read-only (decided in the papers), and when both wrote a chapter house, whose wins at the seal: the players' (suggested) or the Lightkeeper's (today)?

add-illumination-one-press: keep the single press the FAQ documents, or add a two-press confirm only while reports are unfiled, as the 'existing confirm step' wording of decisions_fix4 5 implies; either way the decision text and the build should agree.
leave-rejoin-resets-spend-count: does a member who leaves and returns in the same assignment keep their spend count (like a replacement under #41), or start again at 0?

player-can-self-revive: is Revive the Lightkeeper's only (remove it from the player's sheet), or allowed for the player under detection, not prevention (update the FAQ and name who revived in the log)?

dealt-mark-beside-held-death-defy: when a mark is dealt to a closed desk that already holds a Death Defy mark, should the held mark land first and its offer close (WEBSOCKET.md 4.5), or should the new mark join the offer?
lk-cannot-see-open-burn: may the Lightkeeper's Roll area show a short live note while a player's burn is open, or should it be only a mark on the felt slip to keep #16's help on demand?
burn-preview-omits-drive-die (by design): keep 'Survey: 2 dice' with its i, or relabel it 'Reroll: Survey, 2 dice' with the i unchanged, since four reports from three seats read it as a mistake?
spending-open-after-end: should spending stay open across End Assignment (and End's i say so), or close with the assignment?
illumination-past-12: should +1 Illumination stop at 12, or show the carried-over amount the way Add Illumination already does?
top_fixes: 1. scar-owed-lost-on-restart: store the owed scar in the database so a restart cannot erase it (no decision needed).
2. death-lowers-resource-max-silently: after Robert's call, one maximum on every desk with a circle_update at a death, never a pool above it.
3. lk-charter-editable-before-seal: the players' chapter house wins at the seal, and the charter is read-only until then.
4. edit-sheet-log-truncates-identically: show the part that changed, so detection, not prevention works for text fields.
5. dead-can-file-report: add submit_assignment_report to DEAD_REFUSED and hide the form on a dead desk.
6. gilded-keep-after-restart-shows-outcome with live-desk-burn-after-restart: a reconnecting desk drops outcomes and burn offers the server no longer holds, and says so.

7. non-combatant-not-resent-on-reload, non-combatant-silent-refusal and non-combatant-logs-full-drive: treat Non-Combatant like the other ally offers on reload, reconnect and refusal, and log only what came back.
8. lk-cannot-see-open-burn with lk-roster-card-no-held-mark: show the Lightkeeper what a player still has pending (an open burn, a held mark).
9. touch-targets-under-44: one sweep of post-roll Use and Skip, scar form rows, relationship Accept and the drive picker.
10. lk-sheet-no-ability-used: a Used or Ready marker for once-per-assignment abilities on both desks (also closes F108 and F115).
method_notes: Fix the harness handbook: play4/README.md:120 says the third mark of a kind becomes a scar. The site and the book scar on the mark after a full track of 3. It produced a rules doubt (F092) and shaped the Lightkeeper's plan.

Blind play never reached a scar, an incapacitation or an advance (Cass ended at Body 3 of 3, Illumination 6 of 12), so those paths rest on the side checks only. Next time run two assignments, seed the circle near 12, or give the Lightkeeper a clear instruction to push one investigator past a full track.
Seats act minutes apart, so time windows reported in blind play (F025, F060) are mismeasured; keep timing claims to the side checks with real waits.

seat.js matches names as substrings (F007, Bram's 'button:Ner' with 5 matches): default to exact match or warn on several. Keyboard focus checks must record document.activeElement on arrival before any key (F058). seat.js run scripts lack touch on the tablet, and the scroll command did not move the desk's inner scroll container at 1366x768.
finding.js should check that screenshot paths exist: Ada gave wrong paths for F076 and F077 (the real files are shots/ada/061_r3stitch2.png and 062_r3sheet.png).
The Lightkeeper noticed her dice tray count go from 2 to 1 without touching it (round 2) and did not log it; watch for it next time.

For the next re-check, cover what was not exercised (recheck-not-exercised): the scar form from marks on a phone (45.15), focus in a second tab after a roll, #21 on Safari or a real phone, 60.25 and 60.24 with a test Google client id or on beta, the Lightkeeper's roster card while advancements wait, and #23 on the Lightkeeper's copy after a restart.

Checker pitfalls worth keeping in the shared lib: a Node socket on a character whose desk is open takes the desk over; SQL changes to reports_open do not broadcast (use the Lightkeeper's socket); restart_api.sh needs the database name when it is not the default.
